name: Kwiniaska Golf Club
architects: A. Bradford Caldwell (1964); redesigned by P.B. Dye, new layout opened May 2020

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM, project VT_Statewide_A23 (Vermont statewide lidar, 2023), tile USGS_1M_18_x64y492_VT_Statewide_A23 (published 2026-03-31), NAD83 / UTM 18N (EPSG:26918), NAVD88 m; release data-kwiniaska, clipped to the world + 100 m by pipeline/intake.py raster

ortho.source: VCGI Color Vermont orthoimagery 2021-2025 (IMG_VCGI_CLR2021_2025_SP_NOCACHE ImageServer, maps.vcgi.vermont.gov; leaf-off spring flight), exported through the fetch workflow at 0.5 m in EPSG:32618 for the world box (release data-kwiniaska: kwiniaska_vcgi.jpg), placed by pipeline/intake.py ortho; flight year not stated by the export. NAIP (USGS NAIPImagery ImageServer, leaf-on) is raw/naip_05m.tif, used for checking only

laz.source: USGS 3DEP lidar, project VT_Statewide_A23 (workunit VT_Statewide_2_A23; QL1), flown about 21 April 2023 (GPS times; leaf-off); NAD83(2011) / Vermont (EPSG:6589, m), NAVD88 (GEOID18) m; class 1 (unclassified: vegetation and structures; the project has no vegetation classes); tiles N2107E4445 and N2093E4445 (release data-kwiniaska), clipped to the world + 100 m with pipeline/intake.py laz
laz.label: 2023 USGS Vermont statewide lidar, leaf-off

world.note: OSM course boundary (way 65856105) bbox 562 x 881 m in UTM 18N + ~120 m scenery, whole 256 m chunks, centred: 1,024 m east-west (231 m each side), 1,280 m north-south (200 m each side; the Kwini Club practice facility, out of bounds, fits inside to the north)

scorecard_source: GolfPass scorecard (golfpass.com/courses/1561-kwiniaska-golf-club/scorecard-and-layout), read 2026-10-30: the current par-70 card of the PB Dye layout (opened May 2020; 2021 club handbook: par 70, three sets of tees, about 4,542 to over 5,800 yd), per-hole Black, Black/Gold, Gold, Gold/White and White rows; every row adds up (5,810 / 5,446 / 5,235 / 4,961 / 4,492). 18Birdies' Black row is the same hole for hole (5,810) and gives the ratings: Black 68.1/120, Gold 65.1/113, White 62.2/104 (men). Stroke index from 18Birdies (Hole19's card agrees); GolfPass's men's index differs (11,3,7,13,1,9,17,5,15 / 4,8,14,12,2,18,6,16,10). The pars match OSM's hole lines (4,3,4,3,5,3,5,5,3 / 4,4,4,3,3,5,4,4,4). Unverified: the club's site (kwiniaska.com) shows no card. The older par-72 card (Blue 6,848, 72.7/129; GolfPass's tee table, foretee, offcourse.co, allsquaregolf) is the pre-2020 Caldwell layout and is not built. Built: Black (the back tees) and Gold (the next set forward; the card has no Blue; developer's overnight call 2026-10-30); default Gold.
rough_band_note: a mown band of rough along the fairways, then the longer fescue the photos show beside many holes (art only)

tree_type_ortho.note: Kwiniaska: the class-1 lidar's last-return split called the dark evergreen rows broadleaves; the VCGI photo is leaf-off, so only conifers are green in the woods (course chat 2026-10-30, checked on crops of the photo).
